scope: Documentation and synthetic review fixtures only. No application-code changes or release authorization.

originalReport.preservation: Exact original UTF-8 report, not a shortened replacement.

evidenceArchiveSource.preservation: All four contents are committed as readable individual files; the redundant ZIP is not required.

syntheticProbeRerun.fixtures: Synthetic files in a temporary directory only; original saved evidence was not overwritten.
syntheticProbeRerun.result: Matches the original saved probe outcome.

notPerformed: Real application install, update, uninstall or profile modification
GUI/tray integration execution on a clean Windows machine
Independent byte-level validation of the product release ZIP
referencePolicy: R/W references are preserved in REPORT.he.md. Source-code links are pinned to the reviewed commit. Live metadata and external documentation are a review-time snapshot and should be revalidated before implementation decisions.
additionalDocuments: Implementation plan, validation register and review notes are handoff recommendations and follow-up questions, not claims that fixes were implemented.
